summary: Enlivex Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K press release commenting on the Rain Foundation's $100M liquidity commitment to Rain's prediction markets protocol. The filing details Enlivex’s current holdings of ~79.6 billion RAIN tokens valued at ~$919M and an option to acquire up to ~271.4 billion additional RAIN tokens at $0.0033/token, expiring Dec. 31, 2027. This is a routine treasury update and commentary on a third-party protocol; no corporate action, M&A, or special situation affecting Enlivex shareholders is announced. The filing triggers no event-driven trading opportunity.
